text.p: United States Exploration Inc said Wednesday it acquired ZCA Gas Gathering Inc, a privately held Delaware corporation, for undisclosed terms.

ZCA owns and operates a natural gas gathering system in Osage County, Okla. consisting of about 90 miles of natural gas gathering line and associated processing equipment. It also owns a 100 percent working interest in 76,000 acres of continuous natural gas leases and six producing gas wells.

Completion of the transaction, effective October 1, 1996, allowed U.S. Exploration to expand its current natural gas gathering capabilities in Osage County to about 125 miles of gathering line, providing natural gas gathering services to an area encompassing nearly 150,000 acres.
